headline: The run stopped at 5.7 h, before the 19.0 h horizon, because the wound looked unlikely to close in time; a human approved the stop, and 13.3 plate hours were saved.
summary: At the first check (1.9 h), the tool recommended "Stop, unlikely to close" because P(90% closed by 19.0 h) = 0.094 was at or below the 0.1 threshold. That stop was not approved by a human, so the run went on. At 3.8 h, the tool said to image again at the next check, because more frames would narrow the band. At 5.7 h, it again recommended "Stop, unlikely to close", with P(90% closed by 19.0 h) = 0.058, and this time a human approved it. The run ended at 5.7 h with 13.3 plate hours saved, and it logged no flags and no refusals.
